notes.title: REDUCED PRICE: Get Duke Grabowski, Mighty Swashbuckler - Now only $1.99 - Pirate Adventure Awaits!
notes.notes:
In celebration of the upcoming 1 year anniversary of Duke Grabowski, Mighty Swashbucker's release we have decided to lower the price to less than 2 wooden nickels...errrr...dollars. You can now join in on an epic pirate adventure inspired by a classic series of games that may have had an animal and body of land in their title.

Get Duke Grabowski, Mighty Swashbuckler for only $1.99 from this day forth!

notes.title: FLASH SALE! Get DUKE GRABOWSKI For Under $2 - For A Limited Time!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26421989/0ee2f4adcd20e1f05ac951679f6863e3acfd7135.jpg[/img]

Summer is right around the corner and with that comes a sense of adventure, and much needed vacation time. Why not get ahead of the game and pick up DUKE GRABOWSKI, MIGHTY SWASHBUCKLER for over 70% off the original price?! 

Get your summer on at the tropical paradise known as "Bodacious Bay". While there, be sure to, or at least attempt to, get into the hottest club on the island "The Gnarly Narwhal". A place any would-be pirate captain can go to get there peg leg shaking. 

Want the freshest (organic) fruit grown straight on the island? Be sure to stop by "Sal's Fruit Stand". Just be careful not to bother the monkey's that tend to hang around there. You have been warned.

Take in a good fight at the "Old Stone Pier" where island goers take on the mighty gorilla known as "Queenie". Who knows, if you play your cards right, maybe you can even go a round against them!

These are just some of the hot spots you will discover during your trip to "Bodacious Bay". Pick up Duke Grabowski today and discover your own island getaway adventure!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26421989/e2145803aa371cddf05f3c425c7580d5479223c1.jpg[/img]
